page.title: Event drape rentals you can configure
page.description: Browse curated packages and individual rental inventory, set quantity or linear footage, choose full service or transport, and send an estimate request — final pricing confirmed by our team.
page.heroVisualTitle: Pipe, drape, and polished installs — ready to configure.
page.catalogDescription: Curated packages first, then individual inventory. Prices shown are planning estimates only.
page.packagesDescription: All-in kits with everything included for a polished setup.
page.itemsDescription: Rent single pieces — drapes, hardware, and more.
page.metaDescription: Configure luxury event drape rentals in Montreal — curated packages, individual inventory, add-ons, and full-service install options. Request an estimate online.

catalog.emptyDescription: Public rental listings will appear here once they are marked ready in the product catalog.
catalog.sectionEmptyPackages: No public packages yet — create one in Admin → Inventory (Kind: Package), then mark it public.

configurator.disclaimer: Prices and quantities are planning estimates — not a final quote. The Curtain Guy reviews measurements, labor, delivery, installation, teardown, and availability before confirming rental pricing.
configurator.disclaimerShort: Estimate only — final quote after review. Full service or transport is chosen once in the cart or at checkout.
configurator.segmentsHint: About {segments} segment(s) at {feet} ft each (rounded up).
configurator.packageIncludesHint: Quantities shown for one package — doubles if you rent two, and so on.
configurator.packageLogisticsFullTitle: Full service on Montreal Island included
configurator.packageLogisticsHint: Other delivery areas only add the zone surcharge at checkout — not a second full logistics fee.
configurator.logisticsNote: TCG full service or transport is chosen once for your whole cart — in the cart drawer and at checkout with your delivery area.
configurator.fullServiceDescription: Transport, professional installation, and teardown — recommended for most venues.
configurator.transportWarning: Without full service, our crew will not install or tear down. You are responsible for setup on site. Transport-only still requires scheduling with our team.
configurator.transportDescription: Delivery and pickup only — no installation or teardown.

cart.title: Your rental cart
cart.disclaimer: Cart totals are estimates only. Final rental pricing is confirmed by The Curtain Guy after review.

cart.logisticsHint: One choice for the whole cart — not per product.

cart.logisticsZoneCheckout: Pick your delivery area on the checkout page to unlock the flat transport estimate.
cart.logisticsDiyWarning: TCG will not deliver, install, or tear down. You handle all logistics.

checkout.title: Request your rental estimate
checkout.description: Share event details and we will turn your cart into a reviewed estimate. No payment is taken online.
checkout.metaDescription: Submit your event drape rental cart for a reviewed estimate from The Curtain Guy in Montreal.
checkout.formDescription: We use this to follow up on your rental estimate request.
